Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1147
Claimant:
Lacey Greene
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
January 3, 2024
Claimant reported a low-speed collision in the parking lot of a grocery store while backing out of a space. Claimant
states the other vehicle struck the rear passenger side. Claimant has no lawyer and is handling the claim personally.
February 16, 2024
Claimant described the same sequence of events in a recorded call, and the account matches what was given at the
scene. Claimant reports a wrist fracture from bracing against the dashboard as the impact occurred. The reported
injury fits the kind and force of a collision like this.
March 8, 2024
Photos from the scene and a statement from a witness in the next row both confirm the vehicles came into contact as
described. The damage pattern on both vehicles lines up with the reported impact. No earlier damage to the
claimant's vehicle appears in our records or in the photos supplied.
March 12, 2024
Claimant is still not completely clear on which seat position they were sitting in at impact, and says the memory is
hazy. This does not change the overall description of the collision. No prior injury to the same wrist or arm is known
from the medical history provided.
April 19, 2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, with follow-up visits extending past the usual
recovery window. The treating provider has documented the progression in notes sent to us. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the policy start date.
April 26, 2024
The driver inovlved is a household member of the policyholder and is covered under the policy as such. Coverage
review is complete for the driver and vehicle. Claim remains open pending the final treatment summary and a repair
estimate.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
